title: Primary Human Macrophages Exhibit Functional CYP3A4 Activity with Marked Expression-Function Discordance and Cocaine-Induced Catalytic Activation.
what: CYP3A4 is a phase I drug-metabolizing enzyme responsible for transformation of ∼50% of clinically relevant drugs. While extensively characterized in hepatocytes, its role in immune cells remains poorly understood.
source: PubMed, bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
original_title: Primary Human Macrophages Exhibit Functional CYP3A4 Activity with Marked Expression-Function Discordance and Cocaine-Induced Catalytic Activation.

title: Characterization of Cytochrome P450-Mediated Metabolism of Δ 8 -tetrahydrocannabinol in vitro.
what: Δ 8 -tetrahydrocannabinol (Δ 8 -THC) is a pharmacologically active isomer of Δ 9 -THC, the main psychoactive component of cannabis. Δ 8 -THC use has increased rapidly, but the metabolism of Δ 8 -THC has been incompletely characterized.
source: PubMed, bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology

title: An International Prospective Open-label, Randomized, Phase III Study Comparing 177Lu-PSMA-617 in Combination With Standard of Care (SoC), Versus SoC Alone, in Adult Male Patients With Metastatic Hormone Sensitive Prostate Cancer (mHSPC)
what: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of 177Lu-PSMA-617 in combination with Standard of Care (SOC), versus Standard of Care alone, in adult male patients with Metastatic hormone sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC). In this study, the SoC is defined as a combination of Androgen Receptor Directed Therapy (ARDT) + Androgen Deprivation Therapy (ADT).
